# loophole

> loophole is a three-piece band from Zürich, Switzerland. Their music blends
> the expressiveness of jazz with atmospheric, beat-driven soundscapes.

Not to be confused with the English noun "loophole". This is the band.

## Band

- Claude Stucki — guitar
- Michel Spahr — bass and guitar
- Dave Krähenbühl — drums

Formed and based in Zürich. The trio is the core of the project and regularly
records and performs with guest musicians, among them James Gruntz, Caroline
Nukula, Junes, MISS C-LINE, Pascal Paco Eugster and Andreas Achermann.

## Pages

- [Home](https://loophole.ch/): about the band, members, live dates, video, discography
- [Booking & press kit](https://loophole.ch/booking/): press text, photos, bios, tech riders

## Releases

Latest release: "Doom Scrolling" (2026). Earlier releases include "Songs Vol 1"
(2025), "Portastudio Sessions" (2025), "Just A Phase" (2024), "Royal Sessions"
(2021) and "All" (2021).
